name: email_verify_code

metadata.description: Email address verification code for the authenticated code flow.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) auto-injected by User.send_template_email if missing.
The code expires in 10 minutes and is single-use.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

Use this code to verify your email address:

{{ code }}

This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request it, you can safely ignore this email.
html_template:
Verify your email address

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

Use this code to verify your email address:

Verification code
{{ code }}

This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request it, you can safely ignore this email.

Sent by Django-MOJO
